title: Case workspace with routed tabs, evidence preview and review drawers
scope: Turn the case detail, evidence and review pages into one case workspace: page header with status chip and key-facts strip, routed tabs (Summary, Evidence, Relationships, Findings, Review), evidence list with a preview pane, and review actions (propose, approve, reject, withdraw, refer, request evidence) in right-side drawers with their existing confirmation dialogs

acceptance.text: Every tab has its own URL and fits the page-length budget at 1440x900; the review page no longer stacks the decision, the evidence-request form, suggestions and the trail in one column

All existing review rules hold: separation of duties, confirmation before every action, disabled actions state a reason, no decision without a human; existing DecisionPanel and review e2e tests pass or are updated with the same assertions
Selection reasons, processing state and sources use the TAX-150 product names; RSL values keep RSL labels

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Updated component and Playwright tests on the fixture build

notes.text: Added 2026-11-08 from ADR-044 (one Vati Workspace identity and design system v2) after the user's UI review against Cloudflare's dashboard and Zoho Workplace.
2026-11-11 (ADR-045): Keletso keeps this task in the AI and new UI lane. No task in this lane depends on an open task in the other lane.
